Who we are

About ScoopScore

ScoopScore was built because manually comparing supplement prices across NZ retailers is a nightmare. We fixed that.

Every week, thousands of Kiwis overpay for protein powder, creatine, and pre-workout simply because they don't have time to check six different websites. ScoopScore does it for you — automatically, daily, and without any retailer bias. We were founded in Auckland by supplement enthusiasts who were sick of the manual grind. No sponsorships. No retailer kickbacks. Just clean data and honest comparisons.

🚫
No Bias
We don't take money from retailers to promote their products. Every comparison is driven by data alone.
📅
Daily Updates
Prices are scraped every single day across all tracked retailers, so you always see the freshest data.
🇳🇿
NZ Focused
Every retailer we track ships within New Zealand. No grey-market imports, no misleading international pricing.
⭐
Real Reviews
Where we show reviews, they come from verified buyers — not brand-curated testimonials.
The process

How It Works

Four steps. Zero manual effort on your part.

1
We Scrape Every NZ Retailer Daily
Our bots visit ASN, Payless, Nutrition Warehouse, Sportsfuel, Supplements NZ, and NZ Muscle every single day to capture current prices and stock levels.
2
We Match Products Across Retailers
Using product codes, SKUs, and smart name-matching, we link the same product across different retailers so you're always comparing apples with apples.
3
We Calculate Cost-Per-Serving
Price alone is misleading. A 2kg bag at $80 may be cheaper per serve than a 1kg bag at $45. We do the maths so you don't have to.
4
You Search, Filter and Buy
Browse by category, brand, or product. Filter by price, size, or retailer. When you find what you want, click through directly to the retailer to complete your purchase.

Privacy Policy

ScoopScore collects minimal personal data. When you sign up for price alerts, we store your email address solely for the purpose of sending you notifications. We do not sell, rent, or share your personal information with third parties for marketing purposes.

We may collect anonymised usage data (page views, search terms) to improve the service. This data cannot be used to identify you personally.

You may request deletion of your data at any time by emailing hello@scoopscore.co.nz.

Terms of Use

By using ScoopScore, you agree to the following terms:

  • ScoopScore is a price comparison tool only. We do not sell products directly.
  • Clicking "Shop Now" will take you to a third-party retailer's website. ScoopScore is not responsible for transactions made on those sites.
  • You may not scrape, reproduce, or redistribute our price data without written permission.
  • We reserve the right to modify or discontinue the service at any time.

Cookie Policy

ScoopScore uses essential cookies to ensure the website functions correctly (e.g. remembering your preferences). We do not use advertising or tracking cookies.

You can disable cookies in your browser settings, but some features of the site may not work as expected.

Disclaimer

While we strive to keep prices accurate and up to date, ScoopScore cannot guarantee that prices shown reflect the exact price at the time of purchase. Prices can change between our daily scrape and your visit. Always confirm the final price on the retailer's website before purchasing.

ScoopScore is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any retailer listed on this site.
